title: github fetch_org_members
description: One organization member, built by the connector (OrgMemberRecord). snake_case keys. Empty email, name, avatar_url and teams are omitted.

numeric_user_id.description: Stable GitHub user id. Also in the ExternalID.

email.description: SAML nameId on the saml_scim path, the public profile email otherwise.

teams.description: Team slugs. Absent when team enrichment failed or the member is in no team.
